free_tier.stated: no recurring free allowance on the hosted models; Pro is USD 10 a month with USD 5 of token credit a month, and a 14-day trial of Pro with USD 5 of GPT-6 Luna usage needs no credit card
free_tier.notes: the trial ends when the USD 5 balance is used or 14 days pass, whichever is first, and then converts to the free Personal plan; GPT-6 Luna is the only hosted model in the trial

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters tokens, not objects

interface_detail: the hosted models are selected in the desktop editor's Agent Panel after a GitHub sign-in, and external agents attach over the Agent Client Protocol (ACP); no documented API key or endpoint for calling the hosted models outside the editor was found on the pages read. The term for an editor or ACP interface is not in the interface vocabulary, so unknown is used
tooling: the user installs and runs the Zed desktop editor (macOS, Linux, Windows) and signs in with GitHub to reach the hosted models; the documented zed CLI options open paths, diffs and ssh:// URLs and name no agent command. Headless routes, all run from the user's machine: Remote Development runs a Zed headless server on a host reached over SSH while the UI and the model calls stay local, and the eval-cli crate of the zed repository is a GUI-free agent binary built with cargo that reads provider API keys from environment variables. unverified: whether eval-cli or the remote server can use the Zed-hosted models, because the pages read name only environment keys for eval-cli and a local sign-in for the editor
chaining: beyond USD 5 a month the hosted tokens bill at provider list price plus 10 percent, so Pro adds no discount to a stack; the same Zed account and plan also apply in Delta, the vendor's standalone agent app, and the free Personal plan on the user's own keys is the separate record zed-personal

limits.value: USD 5 of token credit a month, resetting on the billing date; usage beyond it is billed at provider list price plus 10 percent

a monthly spend limit on tokens above the included credit, default USD 10 (a total monthly spend of USD 20 with the USD 10 subscription), settable to USD 0; hosted use stops when it is hit until it resets

limits_note: no request-rate or per-model cap is stated on the pages read; the vendor says hosted models have higher rate limits than direct API access, with no number. Threshold invoices start at USD 10 of incremental token spend
binding_note: the USD 5 monthly credit and the USD 10 default spend limit above it end hosted use first; the spend limit stops use rather than billing without bound

identity_cost.detail: a GitHub account for sign-in (GitHub OAuth with the read:user scope, and the Zed account email is the GitHub one); the Pro subscription is paid by credit card or another supported method through Stripe; the 14-day trial needs no credit card

reliability_note: a failed invoice payment blocks hosted-model use until it is paid; Anthropic retains prompts and outputs sent to Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Fable 5 for at least 30 days
confidence_note: every value is quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-02. The checkout and the dashboard are unverified: behind a sign-up. Whether a headless route can use the hosted models is unverified.
